content: If your symptoms of acid-related issues persist or worsen after using this medication for one week, or if you suspect a serious medical condition, seek immediate medical attention. If you are using this medication daily for more than two weeks, it may indicate an underlying medical problem that requires alternative treatment. Constipation is a potential side effect of this medication. Prolonged constipation can lead to complications such as hemorrhoids or bowel obstruction. To reduce the risk of constipation, ensure adequate fluid intake and engage in regular physical activity. Combining this product with a magnesium-containing antacid or using stool softeners may also help alleviate constipation. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Aluminum-containing antacids can bind to phosphate in the gastrointestinal tract, which may result in low phosphate levels, particularly if used in high doses over an extended period and if kidney function is normal. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, also contact your doctor for guidance. Before taking aluminum hydroxide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. It may pass into breast milk, so consult your doctor if you are breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Antacids can interfere with the absorption of many other drugs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Lifestyle modifications, such as stress reduction programs, smoking cessation, limiting alcohol consumption, and dietary changes (e.g., avoiding caffeine, fatty foods, and certain spices), may enhance the effectiveness of this medication. If you are taking this medication on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Store this medication at room temperature. It may be refrigerated to improve taste but should not be frozen. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
